start_oracle.scope: Exact archived individual duration mixture conditional on realized start, not a joint lineup rerun or a point oracle

minute_bin_point_oracle.scope: Conditional archived point draws given observed minutes bin0/1-59/60-89/90; >=30 draws; no exact start flags or full conditional simulation stored; support-selection and Monte Carlo limitations

distribution.scope: Distribution versus point-mass baseline, not a competing probabilistic football model

limits: Only GW8–10; changing published model versions, not a fixed-model independent holdout
Removing components is a zero-contribution diagnostic, not a valid retrained ablation
Perfect-component corrections use actual outcomes; effects are not additive or deployable
Only individual sampled minutes and points were archived, so exact-start point oracle and true feature ablations require archived replay inputs
Match bootstrap does not capture all cross-match or temporal dependence
